image_description: A blue and white striped fabric baby bib lying flat on a neutral beige surface. The bib features a curved neck opening with a red snap fastener at the top center. It has a rounded, shield-like body shape with visible stitching along the edges (piping). There is a small embroidered detail or patch on the lower right side and a triangular fabric reinforcement or decorative element near the neck curve.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and not a similar textile item like a napkin or placemat.
To verify the structural integrity of the edges, ensuring the piping/stitching is continuous and the fabric doesn't melt into the background.
To check for subtle texture anomalies in the fabric weave and stripe alignment that might indicate AI generation artifacts.

focus_areas: Edge continuity of the piping/stitching around the perimeter
Consistency of the stripe pattern across folds and curves
Structural plausibility of the snap fastener attachment
Texture realism of the fabric weave
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the stripe pattern: does it wrap logically around the curves? Check the snap fastener: does it look physically attached or just painted on? Verify the edge piping: is it a continuous 3D tube or does it blur into the fabric?
